attributes.title: All Logs
attributes.description: Every ingested SmartBreeds log line, newest first.

attributes.title: Errors & Warnings
attributes.description: WARNING, ERROR and CRITICAL lines from every service.

attributes.title: Security Events
attributes.description: Rejected requests at the edge (401/403/429) and CRITICAL lines (e.g. failed DB auth).

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query": {"query": "(http.layer:edge and http.status:(401 or 403 or 429)) or level:CRITICAL", "language": "kuery"}, "filter": [], "sort": [["@timestamp", "desc"]], "indexRefName": "kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON.index"}

attributes.title: AI Pipeline Problems
attributes.description: Warnings and errors from ai-service, classification-service and the LiteLLM proxy.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query": {"query": "service:(ai-service or classification-service or litellm) and level:(WARNING or ERROR or CRITICAL)", "language": "kuery"}, "filter": [], "sort": [["@timestamp", "desc"]], "indexRefName": "kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON.index"}

attributes.title: Backup runs
attributes.description: One line per hourly Postgres backup: the dump was restored into a scratch database and checked (BACKUP_VERIFY OK) or not (BACKUP_VERIFY FAILED, with the reason).

query.query: http.layer:gateway and not healthcheck:true and not user.id:anonymous
http.layer:edge and not healthcheck:true and url.path:("/api/v1/auth/login" or "/api/v1/auth/login/2fa") and http.method:POST
http.layer:edge and not healthcheck:true and url.path:("/api/v1/auth/login" or "/api/v1/auth/login/2fa") and http.method:POST
http.layer:edge and not healthcheck:true and url.path:("/api/v1/auth/login" or "/api/v1/auth/login/2fa") and http.method:POST
http.layer:edge and not healthcheck:true and http.status:(401 or 403)
http.layer:edge and not healthcheck:true and http.status:(401 or 403 or 429)
http.layer:gateway and not healthcheck:true and not user.id:anonymous
http.layer:gateway and not healthcheck:true and not user.id:anonymous
service:classification-service and log_type:access and not healthcheck:true
service:(ai-service or classification-service or litellm) and level:(WARNING or ERROR or CRITICAL)
